text:
The median asking rent in Bielefeld stands at 10.0 €/m², up 2.9 % year‑on‑year and 24.6 % over the past five years, placing the city 23rd of the 37 most expensive markets. The rent premium over existing contracts is 40.0 %, while a 60 m² unit costs about 600.0 € per month.

Market tightness is moderate: days on market average 30.0, with 23.0 % of listings let within a week and a vacancy rate of 1.7 %. Rent‑burden for two residents is 13.3 %, and the market is described as balanced.

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent to reach 10.5 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 10.24 €/m² and 10.75 €/m², a 5.0 % increase.
